AFC Bridgnorth v Sandbach United 

It’s gunna be a wet one, let’s hope it’s gunna be a good one, come on The Bach, let’s get the 3 points!
The Ramblers line up for this west windy fixture @AFCBridgnorth for an important game to keep the momentum going. https://t.co/tTRY4HIHRm

🔵🔵 v 🟢🟢

AFC Bridgnorth v Sandbach United 

Another top 5 clash for The Bach on consecutive Saturday’s, and it’s another early season 6 pointer and sure to be a compelling affair.  Bach welcome Callum Besford as well as a return to the starting 11 for Nathan Barry.

The Ramblers take a break from playing at home for a rare away game and a first visit to Crown Meadow to face in form @AFCBridgnorth  on Saturday 24/10/26 3pm KO. With both teams challenging and playing well this is sure to be another cracking league fixture in the @nwcfl https://t.co/iRisDk9Hch

Top on Friday, Top day Saturday with the important 1 0 win against Bilston and that means we are Top on Sunday.

A TOP weekend for the Bach team and supporters 🔵⚪️😍😍😍
Dec and JKD sum up an important 3 points against 2nd placed Bilston with a 1  0 win courtesy of a Matty Birchall goal, get in The Bach! https://t.co/VJgSyiGjbO
